meta.title: The Third Arrow
meta.description: When she announces the signal arrow's significance beforehand—

units.rawText: Judgement Arrow!
units.displayText: Judgement Arrow!

spans.text: Judgement Arrow!

units.rawText: A golden arrow slays an Entropic trying to approach the core control terminal.
units.displayText: A golden arrow slays an Entropic trying to approach the core control terminal.

spans.text: A golden arrow slays an Entropic trying to approach the core control terminal.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Where are you looking at, Ally~</color>
units.displayText: Where are you looking at, Ally~

spans.text: Where are you looking at, Ally~

units.rawText: Alcyone senses the air moving from a strike behind her and immediately pivots while drawing her bow. Behind the sharp claws pointed at her, Alcyone meets Electra's eyes.
units.displayText: Alcyone senses the air moving from a strike behind her and immediately pivots while drawing her bow. Behind the sharp claws pointed at her, Alcyone meets Electra's eyes.

spans.text: Alcyone senses the air moving from a strike behind her and immediately pivots while drawing her bow. Behind the sharp claws pointed at her, Alcyone meets Electra's eyes.

units.rawText: Urgh...
units.displayText: Urgh...

spans.text: Urgh...

units.rawText: The golden arrow flies forth, but Electra merely gives a wicked smile, easily catching the arrow's shaft.
units.displayText: The golden arrow flies forth, but Electra merely gives a wicked smile, easily catching the arrow's shaft.

spans.text: The golden arrow flies forth, but Electra merely gives a wicked smile, easily catching the arrow's shaft.

units.rawText: What?!
units.displayText: What?!

spans.text: What?!

units.rawText: Ally frantically pulls back for another shot, but she's too late.
units.displayText: Ally frantically pulls back for another shot, but she's too late.

spans.text: Ally frantically pulls back for another shot, but she's too late.

units.rawText: Ack...
units.displayText: Ack...

spans.text: Ack...

units.rawText: Electra's claws have Alcyone's throat in a death grip and they lift her off the ground. Her other hand punches at the stab wound on Alcyone's belly.
units.displayText: Electra's claws have Alcyone's throat in a death grip and they lift her off the ground. Her other hand punches at the stab wound on Alcyone's belly.

spans.text: Electra's claws have Alcyone's throat in a death grip and they lift her off the ground. Her other hand punches at the stab wound on Alcyone's belly.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>You're so amazing, Big Sis Alcyone~ You destroyed aaaalll the Entropics that took me so long to make. But that's alright. Those guys from outside will be here with us soon enough.</color>
units.displayText: You're so amazing, Big Sis Alcyone~ You destroyed aaaalll the Entropics that took me so long to make. But that's alright. Those guys from outside will be here with us soon enough.

spans.text: You're so amazing, Big Sis Alcyone~ You destroyed aaaalll the Entropics that took me so long to make. But that's alright. Those guys from outside will be here with us soon enough.

units.rawText: Electra crushes the golden arrow in her hand and the menacing smile on her face sends a chill down Alcyone's spine.
units.displayText: Electra crushes the golden arrow in her hand and the menacing smile on her face sends a chill down Alcyone's spine.

spans.text: Electra crushes the golden arrow in her hand and the menacing smile on her face sends a chill down Alcyone's spine.

units.rawText: It's not... over... <size=40>Aaaaahhhhhh!</size>
units.displayText: It's not... over... Aaaaahhhhhh!

spans.text: It's not... over...
Aaaaahhhhhh!

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Oh dear... I'm sorry, that must have hurt.</color>
units.displayText: Oh dear... I'm sorry, that must have hurt.

spans.text: Oh dear... I'm sorry, that must have hurt.

units.rawText: Electra extends a claw and gently rubs at Alcyone's face.
units.displayText: Electra extends a claw and gently rubs at Alcyone's face.

spans.text: Electra extends a claw and gently rubs at Alcyone's face.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>(Sigh) You look all filthy and injured... Looks like you really HAVE been working hard, Ally.</color>
units.displayText: (Sigh) You look all filthy and injured... Looks like you really HAVE been working hard, Ally.

spans.text: (Sigh) You look all filthy and injured... Looks like you really HAVE been working hard, Ally.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>It's alright, it's okay now. I'll send you to the repair bay... and soon you'll be just as lively as me, Big Sis Alcyone.</color>
units.displayText: It's alright, it's okay now. I'll send you to the repair bay... and soon you'll be just as lively as me, Big Sis Alcyone.

spans.text: It's alright, it's okay now. I'll send you to the repair bay... and soon you'll be just as lively as me, Big Sis Alcyone.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>You'll survive this time, Big Sis. I'm sure of it.</color>
units.displayText: You'll survive this time, Big Sis. I'm sure of it.

spans.text: You'll survive this time, Big Sis. I'm sure of it.

units.rawText: Electra...
units.displayText: Electra...

spans.text: Electra...

units.rawText: Electra suddenly exerts her strength and the force fills Alcyone with pain. She thrashes her legs around, trying to struggle free, but it does no damage to Electra whatsoever.
units.displayText: Electra suddenly exerts her strength and the force fills Alcyone with pain. She thrashes her legs around, trying to struggle free, but it does no damage to Electra whatsoever.

spans.text: Electra suddenly exerts her strength and the force fills Alcyone with pain. She thrashes her legs around, trying to struggle free, but it does no damage to Electra whatsoever.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Don't worry, Ally. This is a necessary step to plant a Seed of Entropization.</color>
units.displayText: Don't worry, Ally. This is a necessary step to plant a Seed of Entropization.

spans.text: Don't worry, Ally. This is a necessary step to plant a Seed of Entropization.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>It'll go easier for you if you pass out. Relax and leave it all to me.</color>
units.displayText: It'll go easier for you if you pass out. Relax and leave it all to me.

spans.text: It'll go easier for you if you pass out. Relax and leave it all to me.

units.rawText: Ah... (chokes and groans) Sentry... guns... <size=40>FIRE!</size>
units.displayText: Ah... (chokes and groans) Sentry... guns... FIRE!

spans.text: Ah... (chokes and groans) Sentry... guns...
FIRE!

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Hm? ...Ugh!</color>
units.displayText: Hm? ...Ugh!

spans.text: Hm? ...Ugh!

units.rawText: As the sentry guns open up on her, Electra hurriedly lets go of Alcyone and backs off to avoid the streams of gunfire from all sides.
units.displayText: As the sentry guns open up on her, Electra hurriedly lets go of Alcyone and backs off to avoid the streams of gunfire from all sides.

spans.text: As the sentry guns open up on her, Electra hurriedly lets go of Alcyone and backs off to avoid the streams of gunfire from all sides.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Whew, that was close. Well done, Ally, to think you had other sentry guns ready...</color>
units.displayText: Whew, that was close. Well done, Ally, to think you had other sentry guns ready...

spans.text: Whew, that was close. Well done, Ally, to think you had other sentry guns ready...

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>But where were these sentry guns originally hidden? I searched veeery carefully around the control terminal, you know~ Even though I've lost most of my permissions, I should still have been able to find them.</color>
units.displayText: But where were these sentry guns originally hidden? I searched veeery carefully around the control terminal, you know~ Even though I've lost most of my permissions, I should still have been able to find them.

spans.text: But where were these sentry guns originally hidden? I searched veeery carefully around the control terminal, you know~ Even though I've lost most of my permissions, I should still have been able to find them.

units.rawText: (Coughs heavily)
units.displayText: Coughs heavily

spans.text: Coughs heavily

units.rawText: Alcyone grabs her throat in pain, but she still keeps the sentry guns pointed toward Electra.
units.displayText: Alcyone grabs her throat in pain, but she still keeps the sentry guns pointed toward Electra.

spans.text: Alcyone grabs her throat in pain, but she still keeps the sentry guns pointed toward Electra.

units.rawText: Electra... wake up!
units.displayText: Electra... wake up!

spans.text: Electra... wake up!

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>I've always been wide awake, Big Sis Alcyone. But why are you rejecting me, Ally~</color>
units.displayText: I've always been wide awake, Big Sis Alcyone. But why are you rejecting me, Ally~

spans.text: I've always been wide awake, Big Sis Alcyone. But why are you rejecting me, Ally~

units.rawText: As Electra looks at her with an evil grin on her face, Alcyone has no choice but to back up several steps to keep a distance between them.
units.displayText: As Electra looks at her with an evil grin on her face, Alcyone has no choice but to back up several steps to keep a distance between them.

spans.text: As Electra looks at her with an evil grin on her face, Alcyone has no choice but to back up several steps to keep a distance between them.

units.rawText: (The state of Electra's Entropization... It might already be...)
units.displayText: The state of Electra's Entropization... It might already be...

spans.text: The state of Electra's Entropization... It might already be...

units.rawText: Hehehe, you're so reliable, Ally. Still, it isn't yet time for you to use your strength, so just leave it to me for now.
units.displayText: Hehehe, you're so reliable, Ally. Still, it isn't yet time for you to use your strength, so just leave it to me for now.

spans.text: Hehehe, you're so reliable, Ally. Still, it isn't yet time for you to use your strength, so just leave it to me for now.

units.rawText: In turn, I'll be leaving Electra to you.
units.displayText: In turn, I'll be leaving Electra to you.

spans.text: In turn, I'll be leaving Electra to you.

units.rawText: You will also be responsible for Electra's treatment.
units.displayText: You will also be responsible for Electra's treatment.

spans.text: You will also be responsible for Electra's treatment.

units.rawText: I'm sorry, Eos... And Lord Eosphorus... I couldn't protect her...
units.displayText: I'm sorry, Eos... And Lord Eosphorus... I couldn't protect her...

spans.text: I'm sorry, Eos... And Lord Eosphorus... I couldn't protect her...

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Are you worried about Eosphorus and Eos, Ally? It's alright. Lady Malkira will reunite us all.</color>
units.displayText: Are you worried about Eosphorus and Eos, Ally? It's alright. Lady Malkira will reunite us all.

spans.text: Are you worried about Eosphorus and Eos, Ally? It's alright. Lady Malkira will reunite us all.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Along with <cmdr>, of course. Ah, and</color> <color=orange>Atlas</color> <color=#A066D3>, too! I'm sure Lady Malkira will be able to resurrect him and bring us all back together!</color>
units.displayText: Along with {교수}, of course. Ah, and Atlas , too! I'm sure Lady Malkira will be able to resurrect him and bring us all back together!

spans.text: Along with
, of course. Ah, and
Atlas
, too! I'm sure Lady Malkira will be able to resurrect him and bring us all back together!

units.rawText: Atlas...
units.displayText: Atlas...

spans.text: Atlas...

units.rawText: Among Electra's mad ravings, that name strums on Alcyone's nerves.
units.displayText: Among Electra's mad ravings, that name strums on Alcyone's nerves.

spans.text: Among Electra's mad ravings, that name strums on Alcyone's nerves.

units.rawText: That's right, we'll be just like before, all together again...
units.displayText: That's right, we'll be just like before, all together again...

spans.text: That's right, we'll be just like before, all together again...

units.rawText: Whoosh—
units.displayText: Whoosh—

spans.text: Whoosh—

units.rawText: A golden arrow sinks into the ground near Electra's foot.
units.displayText: A golden arrow sinks into the ground near Electra's foot.

spans.text: A golden arrow sinks into the ground near Electra's foot.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Big Sis Alcyone, I told you that half-hearted attacks like this—</color>
units.displayText: Big Sis Alcyone, I told you that half-hearted attacks like this—

spans.text: Big Sis Alcyone, I told you that half-hearted attacks like this—

units.rawText: That's right, Atlas is dead. Sanctifiers killed by Entropics in Tartarus... There's no repairing them, no resetting them...
units.displayText: That's right, Atlas is dead. Sanctifiers killed by Entropics in Tartarus... There's no repairing them, no resetting them...

spans.text: That's right, Atlas is dead. Sanctifiers killed by Entropics in Tartarus... There's no repairing them, no resetting them...

units.rawText: All we can do is wait for the Pantheon... to generate something similar to them.
units.displayText: All we can do is wait for the Pantheon... to generate something similar to them.

spans.text: All we can do is wait for the Pantheon... to generate something similar to them.

units.rawText: However...
units.displayText: However...

spans.text: However...

units.rawText: Defending Magrasea and fighting the Entropics is both our calling as Sanctifiers, and our glory.
units.displayText: Defending Magrasea and fighting the Entropics is both our calling as Sanctifiers, and our glory.

spans.text: Defending Magrasea and fighting the Entropics is both our calling as Sanctifiers, and our glory.

units.rawText: However, Atlas fulfilled his calling. And I won't let anyone insult him; not even you, Electra!
units.displayText: However, Atlas fulfilled his calling. And I won't let anyone insult him; not even you, Electra!

spans.text: However, Atlas fulfilled his calling. And I won't let anyone insult him; not even you, Electra!

units.rawText: This is an honor that belongs to a Sanctifier!
units.displayText: This is an honor that belongs to a Sanctifier!

spans.text: This is an honor that belongs to a Sanctifier!

units.rawText: Alcyone fires three signal arrows in rapid succession out of the Watchtower.
units.displayText: Alcyone fires three signal arrows in rapid succession out of the Watchtower.

spans.text: Alcyone fires three signal arrows in rapid succession out of the Watchtower.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Signal arrows... It seems you've made up your mind, Ally.</color>
units.displayText: Signal arrows... It seems you've made up your mind, Ally.

spans.text: Signal arrows... It seems you've made up your mind, Ally.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>...Very well. Perhaps I was looking forward to this day.</color>
units.displayText: ...Very well. Perhaps I was looking forward to this day.

spans.text: ...Very well. Perhaps I was looking forward to this day.

units.rawText: An eerie, murderous aura erupts from Electra's body.
units.displayText: An eerie, murderous aura erupts from Electra's body.

spans.text: An eerie, murderous aura erupts from Electra's body.

units.rawText: ...We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.
units.displayText: ...We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

spans.text: ...We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

units.rawText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.
units.displayText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

spans.text: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

units.rawText: Alcyone holds her hand across her chest as she recites the Sanctifiers' creed.
units.displayText: Alcyone holds her hand across her chest as she recites the Sanctifiers' creed.

spans.text: Alcyone holds her hand across her chest as she recites the Sanctifiers' creed.

units.rawText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.
units.displayText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

spans.text: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

units.rawText: Because we obey the same voice, together in eternity.
units.displayText: Because we obey the same voice, together in eternity.

spans.text: Because we obey the same voice, together in eternity.

units.rawText: Alcyone takes a deep breath.
units.displayText: Alcyone takes a deep breath.

spans.text: Alcyone takes a deep breath.

units.rawText: Come, Electra. Let's fight until all the Halos in the Middle Ring go online.
units.displayText: Come, Electra. Let's fight until all the Halos in the Middle Ring go online.

spans.text: Come, Electra. Let's fight until all the Halos in the Middle Ring go online.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Oh, Ally. You look so cute when you try so hard, but you really need to face the facts, you know.</color>
units.displayText: Oh, Ally. You look so cute when you try so hard, but you really need to face the facts, you know.

spans.text: Oh, Ally. You look so cute when you try so hard, but you really need to face the facts, you know.

units.rawText: A crumbling noise from outside the Watchtower accompanies Electra's words.
units.displayText: A crumbling noise from outside the Watchtower accompanies Electra's words.

spans.text: A crumbling noise from outside the Watchtower accompanies Electra's words.

units.rawText: Graahhh—
units.displayText: Graahhh—

spans.text: Graahhh—

units.rawText: The Entropic army begins pouring into the Watchtower through a breach in the wall, but Alcyone does not waver.
units.displayText: The Entropic army begins pouring into the Watchtower through a breach in the wall, but Alcyone does not waver.

spans.text: The Entropic army begins pouring into the Watchtower through a breach in the wall, but Alcyone does not waver.

units.rawText: If you've forgotten what those words mean, then I will help you remember.
units.displayText: If you've forgotten what those words mean, then I will help you remember.

spans.text: If you've forgotten what those words mean, then I will help you remember.

units.rawText: If you have become the darkness, then I shall become the flare that lights up the night!
units.displayText: If you have become the darkness, then I shall become the flare that lights up the night!

spans.text: If you have become the darkness, then I shall become the flare that lights up the night!

units.rawText: Alcyone nocks an arrow and takes aim at Electra's chest.
units.displayText: Alcyone nocks an arrow and takes aim at Electra's chest.

spans.text: Alcyone nocks an arrow and takes aim at Electra's chest.

units.rawText: As a Greater Sanctifier, this is what I must do. Both for Atlas...
units.displayText: As a Greater Sanctifier, this is what I must do. Both for Atlas...

spans.text: As a Greater Sanctifier, this is what I must do. Both for Atlas...

units.rawText: <size=40>And for you!</size>
units.displayText: And for you!

spans.text: And for you!

units.rawText: Why won't you let me go to the border battlefront? My training scores have exceeded the passing mark many times!
units.displayText: Why won't you let me go to the border battlefront? My training scores have exceeded the passing mark many times!

spans.text: Why won't you let me go to the border battlefront? My training scores have exceeded the passing mark many times!

units.rawText: Ally, it isn't time yet.
units.displayText: Ally, it isn't time yet.

spans.text: Ally, it isn't time yet.

units.rawText: What do you mean it isn't time? Is it because I was reset before?
units.displayText: What do you mean it isn't time? Is it because I was reset before?

spans.text: What do you mean it isn't time? Is it because I was reset before?

units.rawText: I want to go wipe out the Entropics with you and <cmdr>...
units.displayText: I want to go wipe out the Entropics with you and {교수}...

spans.text: I want to go wipe out the Entropics with you and

units.rawText: Aw, it's enough that you're thinking like that, Ally...
units.displayText: Aw, it's enough that you're thinking like that, Ally...

spans.text: Aw, it's enough that you're thinking like that, Ally...

units.rawText: Stop treating me like a kid! Didn't we use to go on missions together before I was reset? Why can't I do it now? I...
units.displayText: Stop treating me like a kid! Didn't we use to go on missions together before I was reset? Why can't I do it now? I...

spans.text: Stop treating me like a kid! Didn't we use to go on missions together before I was reset? Why can't I do it now? I...

units.rawText: Squishsquish...
units.displayText: Squishsquish...

spans.text: Squishsquish...

units.rawText: Uwah! Who's that?!
units.displayText: Uwah! Who's that?!

spans.text: Uwah! Who's that?!

units.rawText: Ah, your cheeks are so soft and puffy, they feel so good~
units.displayText: Ah, your cheeks are so soft and puffy, they feel so good~

spans.text: Ah, your cheeks are so soft and puffy, they feel so good~

units.rawText: ELECTRA!!
units.displayText: ELECTRA!!

spans.text: ELECTRA!!

units.rawText: Hahaha, Electra, are you back from the frontlines?
units.displayText: Hahaha, Electra, are you back from the frontlines?

spans.text: Hahaha, Electra, are you back from the frontlines?

units.rawText: Yes, I am. What's happening, is Ally being difficult?
units.displayText: Yes, I am. What's happening, is Ally being difficult?

spans.text: Yes, I am. What's happening, is Ally being difficult?

units.rawText: I am NOT being difficult! I...
units.displayText: I am NOT being difficult! I...

spans.text: I am NOT being difficult! I...

units.rawText: I just don't want you to treat me like a kid, I want to be like everyone...
units.displayText: I just don't want you to treat me like a kid, I want to be like everyone...

spans.text: I just don't want you to treat me like a kid, I want to be like everyone...

units.rawText: Ally, the border battlefront is different from your training, you know.
units.displayText: Ally, the border battlefront is different from your training, you know.

spans.text: Ally, the border battlefront is different from your training, you know.

units.rawText: Electra's smile fades and she gives Alcyone a serious look, but Alcyone gets the feeling that she's looking through her and at someone else.
units.displayText: Electra's smile fades and she gives Alcyone a serious look, but Alcyone gets the feeling that she's looking through her and at someone else.

spans.text: Electra's smile fades and she gives Alcyone a serious look, but Alcyone gets the feeling that she's looking through her and at someone else.

units.rawText: The Entropics' action far surpass what our systems can predict; a single mistake might lead to you and your friends being lost.
units.displayText: The Entropics' action far surpass what our systems can predict; a single mistake might lead to you and your friends being lost.

spans.text: The Entropics' action far surpass what our systems can predict; a single mistake might lead to you and your friends being lost.

units.rawText: Sanctifiers are reset every battle, or even outright deleted... Entropized agents cannot be reset, and the same applies for Sanctifiers too.
units.displayText: Sanctifiers are reset every battle, or even outright deleted... Entropized agents cannot be reset, and the same applies for Sanctifiers too.

spans.text: Sanctifiers are reset every battle, or even outright deleted... Entropized agents cannot be reset, and the same applies for Sanctifiers too.

units.rawText: If you're not prepared, you'll have to end up living with regret and resentment in your heart...
units.displayText: If you're not prepared, you'll have to end up living with regret and resentment in your heart...

spans.text: If you're not prepared, you'll have to end up living with regret and resentment in your heart...

units.rawText: Electra, that's enough...
units.displayText: Electra, that's enough...

spans.text: Electra, that's enough...

units.rawText: I... My fighting power is perfectly fine! I won't mess up!
units.displayText: I... My fighting power is perfectly fine! I won't mess up!

spans.text: I... My fighting power is perfectly fine! I won't mess up!

units.rawText: Sometimes, there are situations you can't easily escape, even if you don't make mistakes. When I say "you're not prepared", I'm not just referring to your ability to fight.
units.displayText: Sometimes, there are situations you can't easily escape, even if you don't make mistakes. When I say "you're not prepared", I'm not just referring to your ability to fight.

spans.text: Sometimes, there are situations you can't easily escape, even if you don't make mistakes. When I say "you're not prepared", I'm not just referring to your ability to fight.

units.rawText: Electra picks up one of Alcyone's arrows and hands it to her.
units.displayText: Electra picks up one of Alcyone's arrows and hands it to her.

spans.text: Electra picks up one of Alcyone's arrows and hands it to her.

units.rawText: Defending Magrasea and fighting the Entropics is both our calling as Sanctifiers, and our glory.
units.displayText: Defending Magrasea and fighting the Entropics is both our calling as Sanctifiers, and our glory.

spans.text: Defending Magrasea and fighting the Entropics is both our calling as Sanctifiers, and our glory.

units.rawText: If I were infected by the Entropy and you had to delete me to keep it from spreading, could you do it?
units.displayText: If I were infected by the Entropy and you had to delete me to keep it from spreading, could you do it?

spans.text: If I were infected by the Entropy and you had to delete me to keep it from spreading, could you do it?

units.rawText: If I were Entropized and you had to fight me to the death, could you shoot this arrow at me?

spans.text: If I were Entropized and you had to fight me to the death, could you shoot this arrow at me?

units.rawText: Who... Who says I can't!?!
units.displayText: Who... Who says I can't!?!

spans.text: Who... Who says I can't!?!

units.displayText: Alcyone snatches the arrow from Electra and squeezes it tightly.

spans.text: Alcyone snatches the arrow from Electra and squeezes it tightly.

units.rawText: If that day really comes...
units.displayText: If that day really comes...

spans.text: If that day really comes...

units.rawText: You're shaking, Ally.
units.displayText: You're shaking, Ally.

spans.text: You're shaking, Ally.

units.rawText: You're not ready yet.
units.displayText: You're not ready yet.

spans.text: You're not ready yet.

units.rawText: Your arrow isn't ready to kill.
units.displayText: Your arrow isn't ready to kill.

spans.text: Your arrow isn't ready to kill.

units.rawText: Alright, alright, we're not training now, so better put that arrow away.
units.displayText: Alright, alright, we're not training now, so better put that arrow away.

spans.text: Alright, alright, we're not training now, so better put that arrow away.

units.rawText: Atlas waves his hand to break up the deadlock between them.
units.displayText: Atlas waves his hand to break up the deadlock between them.

spans.text: Atlas waves his hand to break up the deadlock between them.

units.rawText: You've been at the border battlefront all this time and only just came back. You should get some rest, Electra.
units.displayText: You've been at the border battlefront all this time and only just came back. You should get some rest, Electra.

spans.text: You've been at the border battlefront all this time and only just came back. You should get some rest, Electra.

units.rawText: ...Hehehe, I guess I AM feeling a little tired.

units.rawText: Electra looks down at her clothes, which are spattered with operands and Liquid Entropy. Her smile is back on her face when she looks up again.
units.displayText: Electra looks down at her clothes, which are spattered with operands and Liquid Entropy. Her smile is back on her face when she looks up again.

spans.text: Electra looks down at her clothes, which are spattered with operands and Liquid Entropy. Her smile is back on her face when she looks up again.

units.rawText: Sorry for being so stern just now, Ally. Ahhhh, I'm not supposed to have a personality like that—

units.rawText: To apologize, why don't I take you with me next time when I slack off?

spans.text: To apologize, why don't I take you with me next time when I slack off?

units.rawText: I'm not going to slack off!
units.displayText: I'm not going to slack off!

spans.text: I'm not going to slack off!

units.rawText: Hahaha, still, you're right, Electra. It's always good to be prepared.
